modes.local_warm: Existing local native snapshot; target data cache warm.
modes.local_cold: Same local native snapshot; target data cache cold before each measured request.
modes.remote: Manifest/chunk restore; prefer memory-served chunks and verify actual serving tier.
modes.live_parent_fork: Fork a running sandbox with active application state; never substitute a prepared template or pooled child.

pool_state: Record separately; pool starvation is not a cache-cold condition.

metrics.api_ms: Client request start to fork/create response.
metrics.ready_ms: Client request start to receipt of the common shell/native readiness marker.
metrics.print_ms: Client request start to receipt of the random interpreter print marker, including interpreter startup.
metrics.parent_pause_ms: Parent pause request to parent vCPU resume completion, from actual host events; report vCPU quiesce separately when available.
metrics.parent_progress_gap_ms: Independent guest workload progress gap including probe resolution; not a substitute for measured VMM pause.
metrics.child_resume_ms: Client request start to child vCPU resume completion.

timeline.origin: Client monotonic request start = 0; client and host clock mapping must be verified.
rules: Use events from one real sample; do not concatenate medians.
Show a representative sample nearest the end-to-end median and a separate maximum sample.
Preserve overlapping intervals in different lanes.
Unaligned clock domains or missing intervals are explicitly unknown, never invented.
Show asynchronous work after print when captured; preparation before t=0 is separately costed.

validation: Parent workload and inherited child process continue independently.
Inherited memory/file markers agree at fork; subsequent writes remain independent.
Destroy parent first and child first in separate fixtures; survivor remains usable.
No global cache drop and no changes to other users' processes.
reporting: Keep native snapshot cold/warm separate from Manifest/chunk mode.
Report unsupported modes as unsupported, not zero.
Report memory-tier hit evidence and preparation/warmup/refill costs.
Live fork is a separate table from template-pool creation.
